limitations: Structural generated-SystemVerilog review only; not a formal proof or full-core runtime/DiffTest verdict.
Only the listed observer/identity/clock/reset/redirect cones were reviewed, not all 1609 generated modules.
Runtime complete event pairing, actual high-level workload coverage, C++ compiler identity, and final emulator hash remain separate checks.
Printf is under !SYNTHESIS and PRINTF_COND_; a runtime initial schema and complete logs are still required.
No performance comparison or synthesis/timing/PPA inference.
